usedFor: Paystack holds transactions and subscriptions, and Conversion Chats runs “Send Template Message” after events like “Abandoned Transaction”.

bestTemplate.name: “Abandoned Transaction” in Paystack, then “Send Template Message” in Conversion Chats
bestTemplate.why: An abandoned transaction is a sale at risk, so a template message gives the customer a nudge.

watchOut: “Abandoned Transaction” in Paystack is polling, so the template message follows a scheduled check.
